failure_rule: Any increasing paired gain, no strict decrease, positive zero-external control, censored exact baseline or failed certificate rejects the hypothesis.
gap: Map paired fee response and negative controls under the existing terminal-suffix model.
hypothesis: For the registered seeds, raising fee from 0 to 2 to 4 weakly reduces exact gain over no-action with external reward 6, strictly for at least one seed; zero-external controls have no positive gain.
information_boundary: Only public tasks, prescribed private beliefs, training-only reservations and past permitted observations enter decisions. Realized synthetic outcomes/costs are accessed only after allocation freezes.
overlap: External incentives and decision-market manipulation are established. Fee effects already occur in DEVIATION #25. This is a small new grid diagnostic, not novelty.
title: Do transaction fees suppress finite outside-incentive attack gains?
